protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-22 path traversal, not withdrawn. GHSA-44hj-4m45-frj3 and CVE-2026-44024 (CVE.org state PUBLISHED, CNA GitHub_M) describe unvalidated ${tag} expansion in file-path templates. At v1.19.2 extract_placeholders (lib/fluent/plugin/output.rb:804-805) does rvalue.gsub('${tag}', metadata.tag) with no path-boundary check; out_file.write (lib/fluent/plugin/out_file.rb:216-217,251-253) then uses that path in FileUtils.mkdir_p / File.open, so an untrusted input tag with ../ or an absolute path escapes the configured directory. Source-to-sink: attacker-controlled tag -> extract_placeholders substitution -> out_file filesystem write.
